intro: Warsaw. You return through contact WAW-17 with the two incident files. This time you have independent records, not just John's account.
evidenceNotes: INC-P17 links the eyewitness, retained drink, vial comparison and recovery record. INC-G04 links the eyewitness, recovered weapon and projectile comparison. Alex admitted helping prepare the disappearance. SOT-17 establishes Holly's earlier survival knowledge, not an attack.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: The drink, the vial and the witness all belong to INC-P17. The identity record links Holly McClane to your wife.

lines.speaker: JOHN
lines.text: It was Holly. At the time I did not know what had been put in the drink. I knew I had become ill. The incident records tell you more about the substance than I could.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: Then I will keep your account separate from what the records establish. They support the administration and the substance link; you are confirming who you were with.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: INC-G04 contains the eyewitness statement, the weapon recovery and the projectile comparison. The other surname did not make her another person.

lines.speaker: JOHN
lines.text: Holly shot me. After that, I stopped believing that changing the subject would keep me safe. I was trying to leave, and I was afraid she would find me again.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: The gunshot treatment predates the flight. I am not attributing it to the crash, or treating a laboratory comparison alone as identification of the shooter.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: Alex admitted helping you prepare an exit before the crash. You already admitted arranging your disappearance. Why maintain the death story?

lines.speaker: JOHN
lines.text: Because I thought being difficult to find was not enough. After the poisoning and the shooting, I wanted Holly to stop looking for a living husband. Alex helped me prepare a way out.

lines.speaker: JOHN
lines.text: That does not make every detail of the flight my doing. I cannot authenticate the control-channel voice. I can tell you why I disappeared. A forwarding address was the one piece of paperwork I intended not to complete.

success: John has answered the incident files and explained that he staged his disappearance to escape Holly. His testimony is recorded separately from the independent evidence. The confrontation is complete; the final decision about Holly remains yours.
nextObjective: Review the completed case before deciding whether to arrest Holly or let her go.
